name: Starlight Leap
description: The creature teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Immediately before teleporting, the creature can choose one creature within 5 feet of it. That creature can teleport with the creature, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the creature's destination space.
